question: Q3: degrees of freedom or score-optimal value of m1.
number: Degrees of freedom of m1: 0 bits (fixed to 0 by the target). Score-optimal value: 0, because a nonzero constant costs +2 ops (tested 0x9e3779b9, 1, 0xffffffff: 597 ops each). The circuit cost does not depend on which nonzero constant it is.
notes: Tools first reproduced: 7-round empty-input vector af1349b9...f3262 and verifier blake3.py (rounds 1,2,3,5,7 on 40 random blocks each, 3-round 0^32||x on 100 inputs, all equal); traced circuit = 595 ops and time_log2 125.10856 (shipped), 0 mismatches vs scalar on 200 inputs. Value dependence tested only on the constants named; cost depends on constant folding of zero and on whether an all-constant G call appears.
held_fixed: other words as in the target; counts from our tracer
reopen_if: the embedding or the prefix changes
